beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Nickel in this catalog?
options: A Glow from the Alchemist's Shed
beginner.explanation: German miners had a second treacherous ore after the kobold. They called this one Kupfernickel, because it looked like copper ore and refused to produce copper.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Nickel in this catalog?
options: A Glow from the Alchemist's Shed
beginner.explanation: Axel Fredrik Cronstedt took the ore that miners had given up on and treated it as an unknown rather than as a bad batch of copper. In 1751 he had a white metal.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Nickel in this catalog?
options: A Glow from the Alchemist's Shed
A Bright Coat on Cheaper Metal
beginner.explanation: Nickel stayed a minor metal until a thin layer of it could make another surface look expensive. Electroplating gave the old devil's copper a domestic job.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Nickel in this catalog?
options: A Glow from the Alchemist's Shed
beginner.explanation: The obvious objection to Cronstedt's metal was that he had simply made an impure sample of something known. He spent the claim on showing what the metal was not.

beginner.stem: Which story title belongs to Nickel in this catalog?
options: A Glow from the Alchemist's Shed
beginner.explanation: Nickel went into coins and everyday alloys, and then into jewelry that some skin would not tolerate. The rash was common enough to become part of the element's public reputation.
